mentions.name: err
mentions.description: An Android/iOS experiment that learns sensor programming by building a simpler fitness-tracking core, intended to replace Strava and other apps the author currently uses.
mentions.problem: Existing fitness apps like Strava are heavier than needed; the goal is a simpler core that can replace them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/gsilvers/err

I've never worked on android/iOS and I know very little about sensors. I'm trying to learn through this experiment. If I can get rid of Strava and some other apps along the way with a simpler core that would be fun.
